npnjs.com npm Maintainer Phishing Campaign

Campaign: npnjs-scam-npm-2025
Date: 2025-07-18 to 2025-07-22 (4 days)
Attribution: Third Party
Cause: Social Engineering
Motive: Remote Code Execution
Impact Type: Code Execution, Credential theft, Remote access

Synopsis

The npnjs.com campaign used a lookalike npm login domain to phish maintainers and publish malicious releases across JavaScript tooling packages in July 2025. Early payloads targeted Windows hosts with bundled native code, while related Scavenger-family releases expanded into browser, environment, SSH, and remote-shell theft. The shared pattern was not a rogue package name, but abuse of real maintainer access on official npm packages developers already trusted.
